name: NGC 4565, warp field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4565, the Needle Galaxy, a spiral galaxy seen edge-on, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4565warp-hubble
story: The Needle Galaxy is a spiral seen almost perfectly edge-on, so thin it looks like a pin. Here Hubble looked out along its disk, in a field the program named for the galaxy's warp, while studying how the disks of galaxies end at their faint outer edges.

claims.text: NGC 4565 is a spiral galaxy seen almost perfectly edge-on
NGC 4565 is Caldwell 38, nicknamed the Needle galaxy, thin as a pin
Caldwell 38 is also cataloged as NGC 4565
The program's NGC 4565 pointing is labeled as a warp field
The program studied disk truncations, the outer limits of galaxy disks
